description: This file defines the PendingTimesheetSummary class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements the ActionSummary interface and provides functionality to gather and count pending timesheets that require approval, tailored to user roles and employee filters.

classes.name: PendingTimesheetSummary
classes.description: A class responsible for summarizing pending timesheets for approval, including counting and filtering based on user roles and employee data.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group identifier for this summary, indicating its category or type.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns a string representing the group name for this summary.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of timesheets pending action (approval or rejection) based on the current filters and user permissions.
